_about: What scripts/ci/repo-hygiene.mjs lets through. sizeCeilings: files that were already over 300 KB when the rule began (18 November 2026). Each may shrink, never grow (max is its size that day); a file is removed from the list when it is gone or under the limit; nothing is added without a reader (a new data file over 300 KB is split, compressed or kept out of the repository). Every entry is a data file or an applied migration, none a document. imagesAllowed: images under docs/ the repository may keep (icons and fonts the site serves): none.

evals/language/results/after.json.why: A recorded language-gate result (the run's every answer). Read by the offline replay and compared by tests; an eval record, not hand-written text.

supabase/migrations/0054_language_pack.s.why: An applied migration (invariant: migrations are append-only, never edited); it carries the language pack's phrases as data.

evals/sim/scenarios.json.why: The simulated customers' scenario set, read by evals/sim and its tests; one JSON data file.

evals/language/pack.json.why: The language pack (the phrasings the planner is tested on), loaded by the language-gate eval and by 0054's source.

evals/language/results/after-claude-sonn.why: A recorded language-gate result for one model, kept as a baseline for comparison.

evals/language/results/replay.json.why: The recorded readings the offline replay runs against (free, zero-wrong): data, not text.

evals/language/results/before.json.why: A recorded language-gate result from before PD1, kept as the baseline.
